# CANDIDATE: DISABLE_MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE_AFTERNOON

**Filed:** 2026-09-05  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE is blocking valid BEARISH_REJECTION entries in the afternoon session (11:30-14:00 ET), causing losses on winner days like 5/01. Disabling this gate during the afternoon will allow the engine to take these entries and convert losses to wins.

## Mechanism

The MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE currently blocks single-trigger trendline_rejection entries in the 11:30-14:00 ET window. We propose to disable this gate only for the afternoon session (11:30-14:00 ET) by setting the gate to false during that window. Outside this window, the gate remains active.
